snippet.title: Balance (Dos game 1993)
snippet.description:
Balance is an obscure German 3D graphics puzzle game published by Kingsoft GmbH, developed by Cyberlogic.
You have to make the main player ball move to the targets by tilting the object.

By the way, abruptly, "Code Fur Scheibe 1 /ID:" message dialog box appears.
If you input any text, the game shuts down suddenly.

By the way, the background music and photo (image) are good.
